methods.label: Recognize the common factor
methods.explanation: Moving terms gives \(3x²-6x=0\). Factoring out the common factor gives \(3x(x-2)=0\), so \(x=0\) or \(2\). Factoring is the simplest method.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing a common factor and selecting the factoring method are within the stated Grade 9 scope.
